edges.reason: Constructor assigns _owner from _msgSender(), so the caller determines who controls every onlyOwner function.
Constructor mints the entire _rTotal into _rOwned[_msgSender()].
transfer and transferFrom pass _msgSender() as the from address into _transfer.
manualswap requires _msgSender() to equal the development or marketing address.
manualsend requires _msgSender() to equal the development or marketing address.
blockBots is gated by onlyOwner which compares _msgSender() to _owner.
unblockBot is gated by onlyOwner which compares _msgSender() to _owner.
excludeMultipleAccountsFromFees is gated by onlyOwner via _msgSender().
_approve is invoked with _msgSender() as spender from approve and transferFrom.
swapTokensForEth uses block.timestamp directly as the swap deadline, making execution time-dependent.
_transfer triggers swapTokensForEth in the middle of transfer processing while reflection balances are being mutated.
_transfer forwards the contract ETH balance to the fee address after state updates.
swapTokensForEth performs the external Uniswap router swap call that can re-enter.
sendETHToFee performs a low-level ETH transfer to a privileged EOA address.
manualswap invokes swapTokensForEth, which makes an external router call.
manualsend invokes sendETHToFee, which pushes ETH out of the contract.
All transferred ETH is routed to the privileged _marketingAddress.
manualswap authorisation is derived from the _developmentAddress comparison.
manualswap authorisation is derived from the _marketingAddress comparison.
manualsend authorisation is derived from the _developmentAddress comparison.
manualsend authorisation is derived from the _marketingAddress comparison.
_isExcludedFromFee determines whether the swap block runs and whether takeFee stays true.
The bots blacklist mapping is checked to reject blacklisted senders and recipients.
uniswapV2Pair is compared against from and to to classify buys, sells and swaps.
_maxTxAmount caps the transferred amount and clamps the swappable balance.
_maxWalletSize caps the recipient balance for non-pair transfers.
_swapTokensAtAmount is the threshold deciding whether the automatic swap runs.
tradingOpen gates whether non-owner senders are allowed to transfer at all.
setTrading is onlyOwner and writes the tradingOpen state variable.
_transfer delegates the actual balance movement to _tokenTransfer.
_tokenTransfer calls _transferStandard to perform reflection accounting.
_transferStandard calls _reflectFee, which performs SafeMath subtraction on _rTotal.
_transferStandard calls _takeTeam to credit the contract balance.
_transferStandard obtains reflection and token values from _getValues for its arithmetic.
_getValues calls _getTValues which multiplies and divides to derive the fee amounts.
_getValues calls _getRValues which computes reflection amounts through multiplication and subtraction.
_getValues calls _getRate to obtain the current reflection rate.
_redisFee feeds the fee arithmetic in _getTValues.
_taxFee feeds the fee arithmetic in _getTValues.
setFee is onlyOwner and rewrites the buy redistribution fee.
setFee is onlyOwner and rewrites the buy tax fee.
setFee is onlyOwner and rewrites the sell redistribution fee.
setFee is onlyOwner and rewrites the sell tax fee.
setMinSwapTokensThreshold is onlyOwner and updates the swap threshold.
toggleSwap is onlyOwner and flips the automatic swap flag.
setMaxTxnAmount is onlyOwner and can remove or tighten the transfer limit.
setMaxWalletSize is onlyOwner and controls the per-wallet cap.
excludeMultipleAccountsFromFees is onlyOwner and toggles fee exemptions in bulk.
blockBots is onlyOwner and writes true into the blacklist mapping.
unblockBot is onlyOwner and clears the blacklist entry.
renounceOwnership is onlyOwner and sets _owner to the zero address.
transferOwnership is onlyOwner and reassigns _owner to a new address.
owner() reads the stored _owner address.
transferFrom calls _approve to reduce the spender allowance.
transferFrom calls _transfer to move the tokens.
_allowances is read and SafeMath-subtracted inside transferFrom.
transfer calls _transfer with the caller and recipient.
approve calls _approve to write the allowance.
balanceOf converts the reflected balance via tokenFromReflection.
tokenFromReflection uses _getRate to convert reflections into tokens.
removeAllFee caches and zeroes _redisFee before a fee-free transfer.
removeAllFee caches and zeroes _taxFee before a fee-free transfer.
restoreAllFee reads _previousredisFee to restore the saved rate.
restoreAllFee reads _previoustaxFee to restore the saved rate.
_tokenTransfer calls removeAllFee when takeFee is false.
_tokenTransfer calls restoreAllFee after a fee-free transfer.
Constructor initializes the Uniswap router state variable.
Constructor creates and stores the Uniswap pair address.
Constructor marks owner, contract and fee addresses as exempt from fees.
The receive hook lets the contract accept the ETH that the constructor-configured router flow requires.
The external router swap can call back into the token while _transfer accounting is unsettled.
The ETH transfer to a payable address can trigger a fallback and re-enter the transfer flow.
_reflectFee reduces the total reflection supply _rTotal using SafeMath.
_reflectFee accumulates the collected token fees into _tFeeTotal.
swapTokensForEth approves the router for the token amount before performing the swap.
